notes.title: Rank History Chart
notes.notes:

Premium Supporter Pack owners can now view a chart with the history of their rank over last 100 played ranked matches. This also allows players to see how close/far they are from ranking up/down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/09808f544a07a7072be6cd8c86e7f52676d2fde8.png[/img]

Keep in mind that matches before this update haven't been tracked and won't be shown on the chart.
"Rank History Chart" button is located next to "View Match History" button.

[h3]"One to be Feared" achievement fix (Alien orb)[/h3]
To unlock the achievement now the player has to win 10 games in a row, instead of 20.

[h3]2 New Premium Skins[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/15184731d573ce5b9142e35f378e6de700f869de.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/461609b9b11352f2aad22615c0fd29e3f7bcd01b.png[/img]

[list]

notes.title: New Orb - Obsidian
notes.notes:
[h2]Update 1.06 is here![/h2]

[h3]New Orb - Obsidian[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/b55d8617bf35ccb60627a249e518c0844a19a07e.png[/img]

Please welcome Obsidian as a 26th orb to join the roster! To get it, you have to unlock a brand new achievement - "Underdog", by winning with 50 players that have rank higher than Yours. For those who already reached Master rank, beating fellow Masters will be enough. As this is a new statistic, it wasn't being tracked before and everyone will have to do it from scratch.

While not very fast, it has reasonable jumping height and enormous power. It's small swerve allows scoring goals with powerful straight shots.

[b]Premium Supporter Pack owners get an instant access to the orb.[/b]

[h3]Premium Supporter Pack[/h3]
3 new premium skins were added for Premium Supporters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/5ef881ef646278600b7aa6154d5e039e28b0c225.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/d29bddb7c595c1865bd4a3dfc16fe7d14fe0c904.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37926613/e87c77b879eab497e873eefa7aae1504ccf71241.png[/img]

[h3]Quick Chat[/h3]
Following commands have been added to Quick Chat:
[list]
[*]Let's roll!
[*]Sorry
[*]To the moon!
[*]#$*%!
[/list]
[h3]Ranked Multiplayer Mode[/h3]
Players who disconnect from the game while winning will no longer lose rank points, and their opponents won't get any as well. The match will also not appear in online matches history - as if it never happened.

[h3]Anti Cheating Measures[/h3]
If you've unlocked the orbs using any sort of Steam Achievement Unlocker, be prepared to lose your orbs, as the game now double checks if the requirements for obtaining an orb were completed.

notes.title: Update - v 1.05
notes.notes:
[h3]Premium Supporter Pack[/h3]
[list]
[*]5 new premium skins added.
[*]Premium Supporters now have an option to see opponent's rank at the beginning of the match.
[*]Premium Supporters now have an option to select a preferred arena. Chosen arena will be picked when they're the host in online multiplayer matches, and in all single player modes besides challenges.
[*]Premium Supporters can now set an option to avoid rainy weather. Works same as the option above.
[*]Premium Supporters can now ban their supporters from attending their game. (Those cheerfull little orbs that jump so happily when you score won't come to your games if you set this option.)
[/list]
Options listed above can be changed in "Premium Hub". The button to access the hub is located in Main Menu at the bottom of the screen, under the Premium Supporter Icon.

[h3]New Orb - Granite[/h3]
Please welcome Granite as the first orb to be added since the game was released. To unlock it You need to score 200 goals in online ranked matches. Premium Supporter Pack owners get instant access. With high acceleration and quite a size, it can provide deadly powershots. Keep in mind it's not meant to be "better" than the current orbs.

[h3]Friendly matches[/h3]
It's now possible to play a friendly online multiplayer match, to test out various orbs without worrying about your rank. When looking for an opponent, the game will attempt to connect with anyone available, not taking rank into consideration.

[h3]Private matches - shot difficulty[/h3]
Players can now pick the difficulty of the shot for their private matches, all the way from "Baby" to "Master", or let the game calculate the shot's difficulty based on their rank - as it does in ranked mode.

[h3]Ranked Multiplayer changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]For Master rank, Player's rank points are now visible in square brackets next to the rank's name.
[*]Rank points capacity has been changed from 5000 to 99999.
[*]Winning against someone with much higher number of Rank Points gets you less Rank Points than before.
[*]Masters with Rank Points above 5000 will gradually gain less Rank Points for their wins.
[*]Losing in a penalty shootout makes you lose 25% less Rank Points than you normally would.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes & minor changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where Your opponent's orb wasn't visible on the final match screen, when they won.
[*]Fixed an issue where wet/dry materials for orbs were not loading as they should in online matches.
[*]Fixed a glitch where the player could jump twice as high when pressing both gamepad and keyboard "jump" key at the same time.
[*]Fixed a typo in description of challenge #77.
[*]Fixed an issue where a collectible for buying Premium Supporter Pack wouldn't show.
[/list]

notes.title: Update - V 1.04
notes.notes:
[h3]Player blocking[/h3]
Since more cheaters tend to appear in the game, an option to block players is now available. To block someone, enter [b]"Multiplayer"[/b] menu, and click [b]"Blocked Players"[/b]. There you'll see recent opponents from your current gaming session (people you've played against since turning on the game), and [b]can block up to 5 players from matching up with in Ranked Multiplayer mode[/b]. Additionally, clicking on the player's profile picture will take you to their Steam profile. If you wish to report them, providing the link to their Steam profile can be really useful in identifying unfair players.

Please keep in mind there's no "team" making this game, I'm a solo hobbyist dev, trying his best to keep things in order. This is a quick solution to the problem as more fixes and ways to deal with cheaters will be implemented in future.

notes.title: Update - V 1.03
notes.notes:
[h3]Dragon orb balancing fix[/h3]
Due to balancing issues with how overwpowered the Dragon orb has been, it undergone some changes. Now it's a little smaller, jumps slightly less higher and is noticably slower. That said it still remains one of the best - if not the very best orb in the game.

[h3]More Quick Chat Commands[/h3]
5 new Quick Chat commands joined the roste:
[list]
[*]Ouch!
[*]How!?
[*]Nice try
[*]Close one
[*]Haha
[/list]

[h3]Server Capacity Limit[/h3]
The server can contain up to 1000 players. Premium Supporter Pack owners have priority to join before other users. Please keep in mind that right now the average player count is far from the limit, and if the game keeps growing the limit of the server will be increased.

[h3]Networking fixes[/h3]
Some improvements were made and the game should have less issues connecting to the server now.

notes.title: Update - V 1.02
notes.notes:
[h3]Improved Matchmaking[/h3]
When playing online ranked matches, the game will now attempt to find someone near your skill level first. It may result in longer wait times for high-ranked players but will be more fair to the newcomers, and healthy for the game in the long run.

[h3]Quick Chat[/h3]
Version 1.02 brings us Quick Chat! While playing online, hold your right mouse button and drag your mouse over what you'd like to say, then release. I decided against allowing users to type whatever they wish to limit possibilities of harassment. Additionally, it's possible to turn off the chat in the Settings.

[h3]Slower deranking[/h3]
When you lose a match against an opponent with much lower rank, your rank won't be affected as severely as before.

[h3]New Premium Skins[/h3]
5 new skins were added for the Premium Supporter Pack owners.

[h3]Option to hide avatars[/h3]
There's now an option in Settings to hide avatars/display pictures of players from appearing in Your game.

[h3]Networking improvements[/h3]
Some optimization and improvements were made to improve the overall online gameplay.

notes.title: Update - V 1.01
notes.notes:
[h3]Multiplayer Leaderboards[/h3]
Multiplayer leaderboards are now available to every player, not just those who own Premium Supporter Pack. After deep consideration, I decided it will be healthier for Dark Roll: Free Kick Challenge in the long run. While I understand this may upset some players who bought the Premium Supporter Pack, I can only promise that you won't regret the purchase, as I plan to add more content for the Premium Supporter Pack owners in future.

[h3]Online Match History[/h3]
Online Match History has been reworked and no longer displays profile pictures and names of your opponents. The main focus point is now on the orbs that were chosen for the match, as well as the rank of the players. Avatars and names of players are still going to be visible during the match.

[h3]Achievement fix for unlocking the Alien and the Rock orb[/h3]
Due to many people having problem with stats counting properly, achievement to unlock the Alien orb has been changed to winning 20 games in a row. To unlock the Rock orb, now the player has to win 75 ranked matches.
